objective: Determine whether M473/M498 exact parent-result reuse can replace its physically expensive 64x1152b 1R1W scratch with nine existing generated 128x128b 1RW single-port macros while retaining an executable deadline-lookahead schedule.

p0_fixes: Restore the frozen M473 task order sample/operator/row-chunk/partition.
Replace the falsely optimal work-conserving greedy claim with an executable one-descriptor deadline-lookahead policy; retain work-conserving and a small-task BFS oracle as separate diagnostics.

frozen_coordinate.arithmetic: Exact signed12 parent/residual reconstruction and signed19 resident psum; no checkpoint or accuracy change.

single_port_schedule.macro_rule: At most one 1152-bit scratch read or one 1152-bit scratch write per cycle.
single_port_schedule.issue_order: Ascending original popcount then ascending row index, identical to M473.
single_port_schedule.parent_edge_order: Prefetches occur in future consumer issue order and feed the existing two-entry FIFO; every parent edge is read independently.
single_port_schedule.producer_validity: A parent may be read only after its topologically prior active row has completed and written scratch.
single_port_schedule.response_latency: A macro read accepted in cycle t is pending during cycle t+1 and enters the response FIFO only at the t+1 edge; it cannot satisfy issue in cycle t or at the start of t+1.
single_port_schedule.capacity: M498 reservation uses queue occupancy plus one pending synchronous read; current consume never credits same-cycle prefetch readiness.
single_port_schedule.forwarding: If the next unmet parent edge reads the current final-write row and reserved occupancy is below two, write data is enqueued directly and no macro read occurs.
single_port_schedule.work_conserving_diagnostic: Issue whenever the current row is ready; otherwise use every eligible non-write cycle for the earliest unmet parent edge. This is not optimal and is never the admission point.
single_port_schedule.deadline_lookahead_admission_policy: In addition to work-conserving behavior, when a ready current final issue would write, the next unmet edge belongs to the immediately next active row, its parent is already written, it cannot use same-row forwarding, and queue+pending<2, hold the final issue for exactly one cycle and launch that parent read. This policy applies whether the current row has no parent or a ready FIFO-head parent.
single_port_schedule.rtl_lookahead_obligation: One next-active descriptor entry supplies parent_valid and parent_id to the port arbiter. Its registers, compare and hold control must be included in M504 matched DC.
single_port_schedule.optimality_boundary: The deadline-lookahead policy is executable but is not claimed globally optimal. A compressed BFS oracle is run only on 260 deterministic tasks of at most eight input masks and reports every policy gap.

cycle_model.pipeline_equation: M473 exact selected-coordinate equation: preprocess[0] + sum(max(work[i], preprocess[i+1])+2) + work[last]+2 per sample, with preprocess=max(product_frontend,160) for nonempty tasks.
cycle_model.comparison: Only per-task product work changes from 8*ideal_issue to 8*single-port policy issue-window; frontend, DMA, tail and commit remain frozen.

macro_model.dual_port_overdepth_proxy: 16 x foundry-QRT DP 128x72m4f using lower 64 rows
macro_model.dual_port_preferred: 16 x compiler-legal DP 64x72m4f; no generated or QRT PPA view exists
macro_model.single_port_generated: 9 x generated TS1N28HPCPHVTB128X128M4S using lower 64 rows and 1152/1152 bits
macro_model.boundary: The two DP values are foundry-QRT fallback/proxy points and the SP value is a generated-view over-depth mapping. Preferred 64x72 DP PPA, integrated post-layout PPA and macro-inclusive power remain open.

materiality_gates.rtl_rule: All four gates plus an independent r2 hammer must pass before M504 RTL is authorized; preferred DP macro PPA stays OPEN even on GO.

fail_closed: Abort on any frozen SHA, task stream order or M473 selected-coordinate drift.
Abort if a scratch read occurs before its producer row has completed.
Abort on simultaneous single-port macro read and write.
Abort if any parent edge is dropped, merged, or served out of FIFO consumer order.
Abort if the reconstructed ideal 1R1W cycle total differs from 389974420.
Abort if deadline-lookahead is faster than the small BFS oracle or slower than work-conserving on any self-test.
Never substitute either known DP proxy for the PPA-open preferred compiler-legal 64x72 DP organization.
Never call a passing cycle audit RTL, Synopsys, integrated PPA, system speedup, or DATE headline evidence.
